Android: one session row (id = record id, code 0, value = duration s) + one row per stage (<record_id>:<n>, extra_json.session_id); HC stages SLEEPING→1, AWAKE/AWAKE_IN_BED→2, LIGHT→3, DEEP→4, REM→5, OUT_OF_BED→6, UNKNOWN→1; a stage-less session gets one code-1 row spanning it. iOS: each HKCategorySample keeps its uuid (inBed 0, asleepUnspecified 1, awake 2, asleepCore 3, asleepDeep 4, asleepREM 5).
